Deep shadow everywhere else, dust motes drifting in the light, faint warm amber glow only around the lamp flame against the cold blue darkness, heavy film grain, shallow depth of field, painterly baroque realism, monumental scale, muted palette of slate grey, dust ochre and cold blue.
